metadata.description: Movemental thought-leader platform skills — tenant migration, content, and authoring

plugins.name: movemental-tenant-migration
plugins.description: End-to-end migration of a Movemental thought-leader tenant: Google Stitch B&W wireframes → production Next.js React (L4/L5) → Supabase type-safety backend parity → tenant config alignment → validation. Install into any leader-site project; the orchestrator bootstraps the tenant-agnostic runbook, route index, and manifest/checklist templates (bundled in the tenant-migration-playbook skill) into a fresh repo, then dispatches to the six phase sub-skills. All tenant values come from TENANT_MANIFEST.md, never hardcoded.
